title: Ham Repeater Usage by Time Block
dataSources: Aircraft messages (`adsb:message`), APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), AIS vessel messages (`ais:message`), rtl_433 decodes (`rtl433:sensor`), RF occupancy summaries (`sdr:spectrum`), satellite observations (`satnogs:observation`), and repeater use (`repeater:activity`).
app: Radio and SDR telemetry from WSPR, APRS, ADS-B, AIS, rtl_433, SatNOGS, and local receiver health feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and log shippers.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=repeater:activity
| eval block=strftime(_time,"%H:00")
| stats count as keyups avg(duration_sec) as avg_duration_sec by repeater block
| sort repeater block
description: Breaks down repeater key-ups and average transmission duration by time block.
value: Time-block usage helps you understand net schedules, quiet windows, and how social patterns change on your local repeater.
implementation: Log repeater activity from a controller feed, RF detector, or linked network software with duration metadata.
visualization: Heat map of key-up count and average duration by repeater and hour block.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks when your local repeaters are most active and how long people usually talk on them.
